Name: Less Ugly Town Interiors
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][color=#fce5cd][u][size=6][b][i]Less Ugly Town Interiors[/i][/b][/size][/u]
[/color][i][color=#ea9999][size=1][b](Disclaimer; I do not actually think that the original interiors are ugly, I just have no sense for names.)[/b][/size][/color][/i]

[size=3]A very simple mod with a VERY long description. [/size]

[size=4][b][color=#d9d2e9][i]Oh wow, I can't believe it. I actually finished something?!?[/i]
[/color]
[/b][/size][size=3]After weeks of grueling work, my blood sweat and tears being shed every minute, my fingers numbing sensation filling my whole hand as my eyes burn holes onto the screen....
..Nah I'm just kidding.
Better town interiors is my lover, but procrastination is my best friend. You know how it usually goes.[/size][b]

[/b][color=#fff2cc][size=4][i]~Brand spankin' new mod, with a shiny coat of paint poured right over it!~
[/i][/size][/color]

[color=#c27ba0][size=5]═ ❀•°❀°•❀ ═[/size][/color]
[b][i][color=#c27ba0][size=5]What is this mod, and what does it do?[/size][/color][/i]
[/b]
[size=3]Well if you haven't read the brief description of the mod, you might have a hard time here since long descriptions is kind of my trademark at this point pfft.
[/size]
[size=3]This mod basically reimagines most of the town interiors into a (hopefully!) better version of itself! [/size]
[size=3]The changes may be drastic, miniscule, or one that you may not have even noticed! [/size]

[color=#f4cccc][size=4][i]Nevertheless, as of version 1.1.3 a total of 20 [/i][b][i]fully configurable and recolor-compatible [/i][/b][i]interiors has been revamped with 3 new custom areas (Lore friendly!) and 10 compatibility branches.[/i][/size][/color]

[b][i][color=#c9daf8][size=4]Compatibility branches?[/size][/color][/i][/b]

[size=3]If you take a look inside the config menu with[/size][size=4] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][/size][size=3], you will notice that there are a lot of interiors that has 2 options. [/size]
[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc]Original[/color][/b] and [color=#d9ead3][b]Compatibility[/b].[/color][/size]

[/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][b][u][color=#fff2cc][size=4]Original[/size][/color][/u][/b][size=3][color=#fff2cc] [/color]is fully compatible with pre-existing vanilla cutscenes, which includes (hopefully) all the heart events until SDV 1.5 and the special order cutscenes.﻿ I went ham on this one, so there are more things going on here.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][u][b][color=#d9ead3][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/color][/b][/u][size=3] is recommended for users with plenty of mods that touches/adds more heart events or does anything into the interiors really. This version is the closest to vanilla, which would hopefully avoid having any clipping issues by townies or custom npcs.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
[size=3]Those that has no optional choices either doesn't need it, or I didn't really see any other mods touching them so I left it for the time being.
[/size][color=#fff2cc]
[/color][b][size=4][i][color=#fff2cc]Config game is strong on this one. Only want [/color][u][color=#c9daf8]some maps[/color][/u][color=#fff2cc]? Toggle them in the game![/color][/i][/size]
[/b][size=3]Yes, you can even change it even while playing. (Though I suggest to not change versions in game as you may need to sleep to get rid of anything weird that might happen :p). 

[/size][color=#d9d2e9][size=4][b][i]I go very in-detail for information to those who are interested below, but those who aren't...
[/i][/b][/size][/color][b][color=#dd7e6b][size=5]
═ ❀•°❀°•❀ ═
[/size][/color][/b][color=#dd7e6b][size=5][b]TLDR;[/b]
[/size]
[/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Got some issues? Try the Compatibility branch.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Issues still persisting? Report in the bugs section![/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]If your issues had already been addressed below, I will be telling you to go back here and read the description.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Mobile? [color=#d9d2e9][b]YES![/b][/color] It's out right now. [/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Expansions? Maaaaybe...[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]SVE? [/size][b][u][color=#ff0000][size=5]No.[/size][/color][/u][/b][/font]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS]
[size=3]Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/135930628?tab=user+files]Luan125Gui[/url] for giving me permission to republish my edit of their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11569]Elliott Interior Renovation[/url]!
This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][size=3][b]AFTER[/b][/size][/u][size=3][b] [/b]reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted!
[/size][b][size=1]Ps. take the time to click on a few things here and there, you might find something interesting :)[/size][/b][b]

[/b]
[color=#d9d2e9][size=4][b][i]Enjoy![/i][/b][/size][/color][size=3]
[/size][size=5]

[color=#dd7e6b][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/color][/size]
[size=3][spoiler][b][size=5]Listen here and listen close.[/size][/b]
[size=4]Just because there is a compatibility version doesn't mean that it's necessarily compatible with everything.
Most that can do is just avoid clippings of customs npcs.
If you're having some issues, then please [u][b]try the compatibility branch[/b][/u] (if it has) before reporting it to the bugs section!

My mod edits the whole interior layout, if you have any other mods that [u][b]does the same[/b][/u] then it'll probably be likely they won't play well together. Yes, this includes [u][b]SVE[/b][/u].
Either toggle the corresponding maps off in the config or pick just one mod! Stay loyal folks.

[u][b]RSV[/b][/u] - Read above
[b][u]ES[/u][/b] - Read above above
[b][u]SVE[/u][/b] - "Ma'am/Sir, this is a McDonald's drive-thru. We don't offer 12-inch footlongs or SVE compatibility here."
[/size]
[u][size=5][b]Use at your own risk![/b][/size][/u][/spoiler]
